defects.description: Incorrect term for Role Status; used "статусы Ролей" instead of the required "Статус роли" (or appropriate inflection).
Used "результаты" instead of the required glossary term "Вывод" for Finding.
Used "замечания" where the glossary requires the term "значения" for default values.
Repeated use of "замечания" instead of the required term "значения" for default values.
Incorrect translation of "safe value" as "замечание", which changes the meaning.
Incorrect translation of "neutral (explicitly set, never inferred)" as "нейтральная (явно задача, не выводится)".
